content.text: prostaglandin inhibitors (ex, indomethacin) modestly ↓polyuria in nephrogenic DI, generally by ⍉more than 10 to 25%

Boxed: NSAIDs ↑risk of serious CV thrombotic events incl MI & CVA - can be fatal; risk may occur early in tx & may ↑ w duration of use. Boxed: contraindicated in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surg. Boxed: NSAIDs ↑risk of serious GI adverse events incl bleed · ulceration and perf of the stomach or intestines - can be fatal; can occur @ any time & w.o warning Sx; elderly pts & pts w prior PUD and/or GI bleed @ greater risk. CI: known hypersensitivity (ex, anaphylactic rxns & serious skin rxns) to indomethacin or any components of the drug product. CI: Hx of asthma · urticaria or other allergic-type rxns after taking ASA or other NSAIDs. Recent MI: ⍉unless benefits expected to outweigh the risk of recurr CV thrombotic events; if used, monitor for signs of ♡ ischemia. Minimize GI risk: lowest effective dosage for the shortest poss duration; ⍉ more than one NSAID @ a time; ⍉ use in pts @ ↑risk unless benefits outweigh the ↑bleed risk; if a serious GI event = sus, promptly evaluate & d/c indomethacin until it = ruled out. ALT or AST three or more times ULN reported in ~1% of NSAID-treated pts in clin trials. If signs/Sx consistent w liver dz develop, or systemic manifestations occur (ex, eosinophilia · rash), d/c STAT & perform a clin eval. Can cause new-onset or worsening HTN; pts on ACEi · thiazide or loop diuretics may have impaired response. Correct vol status in dehydrated or hypovolemic pts b4 initiating; monitor renal funct in renal or hepatic impairment · HF · dehydration or hypovolemia. Limit NSAID use b/n ≈20 to 30 wks in preg (risk of oligohydramnios/fetal renal dysfun); ⍉ use @ ≈30 wks gestation and later (also premature closure of the fetal ductus arteriosus). ↑risk of bleed events w coag dx or concomitant warfarin · other anticoagulants · antiplatelet agents (ex, ASA) · SSRIs or SNRIs; monitor for signs of bleed. OD Sx limited to lethargy · drowsiness · N/V and epigastric pain, generally reversible w supportive care; GI bleed has occurred; HTN · acute renal failure · resp depression and coma occurred but were rare. OD tx: Sxtomatic & supportive care; there are ⍉specific antidotes; consider emesis and/or activated charcoal and/or osmotic cathartic in Sxtomatic pts w.in four hrs of ingestion or w a lrg overdosage (5 to 10 × the recommended dosage)
